deploymentModeContext.hostedProxyMode: deploymentMode === 'hosted_proxy' - Platform provides infrastructure, users cannot manage plugins, adapters, or execution environments
deploymentModeContext.selfHostedMode: deploymentMode !== 'hosted_proxy' - Users have full infrastructure control

implementationNotes.modeKnownImportance: Use modeKnown flag to avoid flashing hidden UI on first paint. Components should remain hidden until modeKnown is true for better UX.
implementationNotes.navigationTargets: Most redirects go to '/dashboard' (company/billing view) or '/' (home/main view). Choose based on context.
implementationNotes.componentVsPageGuards: Full-page guards use <Navigate>, component guards use conditional rendering with && or ternary operators.
implementationNotes.queryDisabling: Don't make unnecessary API calls in hosted mode. Use 'enabled' flag in useQuery to prevent polling infrastructure APIs.
implementationNotes.hostedOnlyBehavior: LiveRunWidget completely hidden in hosted mode - heartbeat system is self-hosted infrastructure.
